title: Cloudflare Scannable API token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: non-hexadecimal eight-character suffix. Twin of "Cloudflare Scannable API token: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of cloudflare-token-user-plain: alphabet: non-hexadecimal eight-character suffix. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
